description: Look up a domain's live DNS and grade its email authentication: DMARC, SPF, DKIM (common selectors), MX, BIMI and MTA-STS. Returns each record, its status and the issues found, with a guide link per issue. A domain checked in the last few minutes is answered from that check (cached, with its age); pass refresh to look again after changing DNS.

domain.description: The domain to check, like example.com. A URL or www. host is reduced to the domain.

refresh.description: Look the DNS up again instead of answering from a check made in the last few minutes, e.g. right after publishing a record. Only once the earlier answer is a minute old.

name: check_domain

age_seconds.description: How old the answer is, in seconds.

cached.description: True when this answer comes from a check made a few minutes ago rather than a new lookup.

checked_at.description: When the DNS was looked up.

guide_url.description: A guide to fixing this issue.

record.description: The record as published, or null when none was found.

key_checks_remaining.description: With an API key: new checks the key has left this month.

monitor_url.description: Sign up to monitor this domain.

title: Check a domain's email authentication
